state.previous_paragraph: With the assistance of GHF, the Company prepared a memorandum concerning the Company and its prospects, which was distributed to the potential buyers, including Party A, Party B and G&W, that had executed confidentiality agreements. The Transaction Committee met with representatives of GHF by telephone conference on April 22, 2016 and discussed the status of discussions with potential buyers. On April 27, 2016,
state.paragraph: the Board met in executive session (without Mr. Eder present) with representatives of GHF and discussed the status of the process, including that each potential buyer had been advised to submit a non-binding indication of interest by May 10, 2016 (which deadline was subsequently postponed to May 19, 2016 to ensure the potential buyers had sufficient time to formulate their most compelling offers).

bid.instructions: Does `paragraph` report that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company? Judge `paragraph` only; `previous_paragraph` is context for names and dates.
